weather: Fresh south-westerly 18 kt with showers. Showers along the coastal strip, visibility 15 km, reducing to 8 km in showers. Temperature 14C, QNH 1008.
challenges: Late patient readiness delayed departure by 20 minutes.
notes: Patient comfortable and stable throughout.

route: Mission: West Coast Industry Support Day 1
missionDetails: West Coast Industry Support, day 1 positioning from Christchurch to Hokitika carrying survey equipment and two industry staff.
weather: Fresh south-westerly 18 kt with showers. Overcast at 7,000 ft with light drizzle patches, visibility 12 km in haze. Temperature 12C, QNH 1005. At Hokitika: cool southerly 15 kt, gusting 28.
challenges: Load had to be secured carefully in the cabin.
notes: Cargo handed over without damage.

route: Mission: West Coast Industry Support remote strips
missionDetails: Industry support circuit from Hokitika covering remote strips and power line corridors in the Hokitika and Kokatahi valleys.
weather: Light westerly 6 to 10 kt. CAVOK, visibility 50 km plus. Temperature 12C, QNH 1027. Fresh snow on the ranges overnight above 1,200 m.
challenges: Maintaining a safe separation from terrain on the edge of the survey area.

route: Mission: West Coast Industry Support remote strips
missionDetails: West Coast circuit in the afternoon: supply drop and crew transfer to a remote site north of Hokitika, plus a coastal recon of river mouths.
weather: Settled with a light south-easterly 8 kt. Isolated cumulus with tops near 9,000 ft, visibility 40 km. Temperature 16C, QNH 1024.
challenges: Light cargo was shifted to maintain the aircraft balance.
notes: Flight completed as planned. Arrived 9 minutes ahead of schedule.

missionDetails: Currency flight with three take-offs and landings plus air work in the training area.
weather: Moderate nor'wester 15 to 25 kt, gusting 35 at altitude. Broken cloud at 5,500 ft, tops layered to 10,000 ft, visibility 20 km with local reductions in rain. Temperature 14C, QNH 1009. Lingering snow on the alpine routes above 1,500 m.
challenges: Crosswind at the training area required extra coaching.
notes: Debrief covered fuel planning and diversion options.

route: Mission: West Coast Industry Support Day 2
missionDetails: West Coast Industry Support, day 2 return from Hokitika to Christchurch with collected survey data and equipment.
weather: Settled with a light south-easterly 8 kt. Few cumulus at 4,500 ft, visibility 40 km. Temperature 11C, QNH 1005. At Christchurch: light north-easterly 8 to 10 kt.
challenges: Load had to be secured carefully in the cabin.
notes: Cargo handed over without damage.

missionDetails: Foothills explorer by helicopter, following the Waimakariri Gorge to the Craigieburn Range and back across the plains.
weather: Light and variable winds. CAVOK, visibility greater than 20 km. Temperature 18C, QNH 1014.

missionDetails: Emergency medical evacuation from Christchurch to Christchurch. Patient was cardiac patient with chest pain and was stabilised before loading.
weather: Gusty westerly 20 kt, turbulence below 6,000 ft. Cloud building after midday, scattered cumulus at 4,000 ft, visibility 12 km in haze. Temperature 14C, QNH 1002.
challenges: Crosswind component of 12 kt on landing.
notes: Rapid response saved significant time. Fuel used about 151 L.
